crossRefs.note: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for…
in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts…
Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t…
Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful…
Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:

translations.web: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
translations.bsb: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
translations.kjv: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
translations.asv: The fool shall be no more called noble, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
